prompt.title: Online learning for school students
prompt.text:
Some people believe that school students learn better online than in a traditional classroom. Others think face-to-face lessons are more effective.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Use reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

You should write at least 250 words.

essay:
Nowadays, the internet has changed the way students learn. While some people argue that online learning is more effective for school students, others believe that traditional classrooms are still the best place to study. In this essay, I will discuss both views and give my own opinion.

On the one hand, online learning has several benefits. Firstly, it is very flexible, so students can study at their own pace and review lessons as many times as they need. For example, a student who does not understand a math lesson can watch the recorded video again at home. Secondly, online courses give students access to good teachers from other cities or even other countries, which is not possible in many small schools.

On the other hand, face-to-face lessons have important advantages that online learning cannot replace. Students in a classroom can ask questions and get answers immediately, and teachers can easily see who is having difficulties. Moreover, school is not only a place to learn knowledge but also a place to develop social skills. When students work in groups and talk with their classmates, they learn how to cooperate and communicate. In addition, many young students find it hard to concentrate at home because there are a lot of distractions such as games and social media.

In my opinion, traditional classrooms are more effective for school students, especially young ones, because they need guidance and discipline. However, online tools can be a useful addition, for instance for homework or extra practice.

In conclusion, although online learning is convenient and flexible, I believe that face-to-face lessons should remain the main way of teaching at school, and technology should be used to support them.
